title: Sandbox Capacity Probe
user: Teams running many isolated agent or customer containers who need a repeatable preflight showing whether networking, ports, mounts, and startup latency will remain safe at planned scale.
smallest_useful_product: A CLI that launches bounded synthetic containers against a chosen Docker/Podman host, records startup percentiles and rule counts, and writes a capacity envelope.
success_measure: For supported hosts, predicted startup p95 at a configured container/port level is within 25% of a subsequent controlled run.
constraints: Explicit target confirmation and bounded defaults; never benchmark a production host by default; isolate synthetic networks; document runtime-specific results.
